purpose: Typed proposed contracts only; no source implementation or scientific threshold adoption
field_notation: Custom machine-readable design vocabulary, not JSON Schema and not implemented validation

EvidenceIdentity.source_ref: fixed permitted source/blob or previous authorized manifest reference

WageContext.generated_after_iteration: int>=1 for later wages; null for numerical first guess
WageContext.generation_snapshot_id: EvidenceIdentity of actual entering inputs used by producer
WageContext.input_authority_ref: explicit input/source-use decision; absence is UNKNOWN
WageContext.run_authority_ref: separate applicable finite runtime grant; absence never authorizes execution
WageContext.tax_treatment: NET_ONCE; tau/sigma cannot be passed for a second household deduction

ProductionWageCandidate.actual_arguments_id: EvidenceIdentity of actual producer-frame arguments; null for numerical guess
ProductionWageCandidate.actual_return_id: EvidenceIdentity of actual source return; null for numerical guess
ProductionWageCandidate.invocation_claim_ref: durable before-entry claim; UNKNOWN if absent or execution fate unknown
ProductionWageCandidate.runtime_source_identity: loaded function/file/source bundle evidence, not caller bool
ProductionWageCandidate.saved_manifest_ref: fixed independent previous manifest if reading old records

WageAdmissionReport.missing_requirements: explicit tuple of evidence or authority requirements
WageAdmissionReport.consumer_ready: constant false in next inert implementation
WageAdmissionReport.real_execution_enabled: constant false in next inert implementation
WageAdmissionReport.scientific_acceptance: constant false; never inferred from byte equality

HAChainContext.wage_admission_ref: same origin wage and exact input snapshot identity
HAChainContext.input_snapshot_id: r_a/r_b/Tt/rb_gap/params/unit provenance identity; no new values adopted here
HAChainContext.grid_binding: original instance token plus b/a/z/switch values, shape,dtype,strides,flags and before/after identity
HAChainContext.initializer_ref: fixed additive asset-times-return initializer; explicit resource_convention required

HADiagnosticRecord.hjb_convergence_statistic: source value-update infinity norm or null; not HJB equation residual
HADiagnosticRecord.hjb_equation_residual: null with NOT_MEASURED unless separately authorized and defined
HADiagnosticRecord.post_operator_ref: actual HJB post_convergence_operator.full passed to KFE
HADiagnosticRecord.kfe_original_operator_ref: KFE original_operator; record any internal CSR representation conversion
HADiagnosticRecord.density_refs: raw and normalized density/vector,shape,F-order and normalization_factor identities
HADiagnosticRecord.source_cell_weight: db*da; source sums over discrete z without extra dz
HADiagnosticRecord.original_stationarity_residual_inf: proposed diagnostic ||A_post^T g||inf on normalized F-order density; null NOT_MEASURED now

HAQualificationReport.criteria_contract_ref: nullable exact previously authorized scientific criteria reference; no invented thresholds
HAQualificationReport.assessment_state: UNKNOWN | BLOCKED | DIAGNOSTICS_NOT_ASSESSED in next inert implementation
HAQualificationReport.checks: per-metric states NOT_MEASURED | CRITERIA_UNBOUND | SOURCE_FAILED | BLOCKED; no missing=>pass
HAQualificationReport.qualification_passed: constant false in next inert implementation
HAQualificationReport.raw_source_flags_preserved: constant true; never rename raw HJB convergence into strict HA pass

BatchAdmissionReport.province_order: exact expected ordered set; not assumed empirical31 from virtual labels
BatchAdmissionReport.origin_reports: complete per-origin qualification records in exact order
BatchAdmissionReport.completeness: all required origins exactly once; no partial scientific batch
BatchAdmissionReport.production_capital_inputs: At only; Bt remains separate household statistic
BatchAdmissionReport.formal_ha_accepted: constant false in next inert implementation
BatchAdmissionReport.real_execution_enabled: constant false in next inert implementation

proposed_reason_codes.WAGE_SCOPE_NOT_PRODUCTION: Numerical/synthetic/saved scope cannot be relabeled as production
proposed_reason_codes.UNVERIFIED_SOURCE_OR_INPUT_SCOPE: Source byte match does not adopt source or formal inputs
proposed_reason_codes.WAGE_ENTRY_UNKNOWN: Unknown or missing call outcome cannot be retried or accepted
proposed_reason_codes.WAGE_INPUT_RETURN_LINEAGE_MISMATCH: Actual frame/return must bind to payload and context
proposed_reason_codes.WAGE_NONPOSITIVE_FOR_CURRENT_CONSUMER: Current household inputs require wage>0; no epsilon repair
proposed_reason_codes.WAGE_CONTEXT_ITERATION_MISMATCH: Wrong order/context or later wage not generated at t for t+1
proposed_reason_codes.GRID_IDENTITY_CHANGED: No grid rebuild/resampling/flag mutation as a repair
proposed_reason_codes.HJB_NOT_CONVERGED: Raw source flag is necessary, not sufficient for strict qualification
proposed_reason_codes.OPERATOR_LINEAGE_UNVERIFIED: Original post-HJB operator/normalized density lineage must be explicit
proposed_reason_codes.CONTAMINATED_RESIDUAL_NOT_ORIGINAL_STATI: Raw modified-system residual cannot replace original stationarity diagnostic
proposed_reason_codes.SCIENTIFIC_CRITERIA_NOT_BOUND: Unbound criteria/norm/weights/thresholds remain unknown, never passed
proposed_reason_codes.BATCH_INCOMPLETE_OR_ORDER_MISMATCH: No partial, duplicate or reordered scientific batch
proposed_reason_codes.REAL_EXECUTION_DISABLED: No runtime activation or consumer release in this design slice

NUMERICAL_BOOTSTRAP19.meaning: existing approved numerical guess only; not empirical wage or a tax proof

SAVED_SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION.meaning: fixed old records internally reconciled; no production credential

LIVE_SOURCE_OBSERVATION_CANDIDATE.meaning: future live collection under a separate matching grant; source/input/runtime/consumer adoption remain separate
